comment: Underwriting rules for the Underwriting page (web/underwriting.html, web/underwriting.js). Owner, 2026-10-26: quote the longest program for the enrolled debt, always; to lower the price, remove a credit card (smallest first, two at most), never a shorter length. Minimum enrolled debt $7,500 (the table's $7,000 band is not used). Rules from config/playbook/Knowledge_Card.md section 4. The page runs only in the rep's browser: nothing about the client is sent or saved.

repo.label: Repo balance
repo.note: In only while all repo balances are half or less of the enrolled debt.

secured.label: Secured loan
secured.reason: Secured debt does not qualify: the creditor can take the collateral.

military.label: Military debt (AAFES, Navy Federal military loan)

excluded_creditors.reason: Regional Finance is secured by household goods: does not qualify.

creditor_list.comment: Cordoba's acceptable creditors list goes here when the owner sends it: names as they appear on the pull (upper case, any of them matches). While empty, the page does not check creditors against a list and says so.
